# The Comprehensive List of LLM Observability Tools

> a curated, source-linked directory of open-source and commercial tools for tracing, monitoring, debugging, and evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Includes a machine-readable catalog. CC0 licensed. Reviewed monthly; last reviewed 2026-07-16.

Every entry links to a primary source. Availability markers distinguish open source, open weights, open core, commercial products, and public standards/resources. There is no paid placement. This independent directory is maintained by aglio-lab, and every entry follows the same evidence rules.

## Main content

- [Full list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/llm-observability-tools/main/README.md): 120 source-linked entries across 11 catalog sections
- [JSON catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/llm-observability-tools/main/data/tools.json): structured entity records
- [CSV catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/llm-observability-tools/main/data/tools.csv): flat machine-readable index
- [Monthly maintenance policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/llm-observability-tools/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review schedule and evidence rules

## Key categories

- Full-Stack LLM Observability Platforms (19 entries)
- Open-Source Tracing and Self-Hosted Observability (9 entries)
- OpenTelemetry and Interoperability Specifications (7 entries)
- AI Gateways and Proxies (12 entries)
- Online Quality Evaluation and Feedback Monitoring (12 entries)
- Agent Observability and Session Replay (11 entries)
- Cost, Latency, and Inference Performance Monitoring (9 entries)
- Security, Compliance, and Runtime Policy Monitoring (15 entries)
- Cloud and APM Suites with LLM Observability (10 entries)
- Classic ML and Data Monitoring (7 entries)
- Discontinued and Historical Tools (9 entries)
